item.title: ▶ Good news for salaried individuals whose EPF is deducted!...
item.dc:creator: Anuskha Rathod · Instagram
item.description:
Good news for salaried individuals whose EPF is deducted!

Check out the whole reel to know what changed.

For more details, keep reading -

1. Taxation: your EPF withdrawal becomes taxable only if you withdraw before 5 years of continuous service. After that, it’s tax-free.

2. The 2-month waiting period: this one applies to final settlement - you can withdraw the full amount only if you’ve been unemployed for more than 2 months.

3. SWP: more details are expected soon on how taxation and interest rates will work after retirement.

Actual implementation will take some time, so no need to panic.

Share this with your salaried friends!

[Anushka Rathod, Finance, India, EPF, Salaried]

item.title: ▶ Gold has fallen sharply over the last few weeks....
item.dc:creator: Anuskha Rathod · Instagram
item.description:
Gold has fallen sharply over the last few weeks.

It dropped from almost ₹1.43 lakh on November 5 to ₹1.20 lakh on November 25.
A quick update: I shot this video on November 25. Since then, gold prices have recovered slightly and are now around ₹1.23–1.24 lakh as of November 27.

But gold is still around 30% below its peak, and the reasons discussed in this video remain relevant.

What exactly happened?

Check out the whole reel to know.

For more details, keep reading:

1. US inflation is rising. The latest PCE data showed inflation increasing to 3.8% in October, up from 3.6% in September. Higher inflation could mean interest rates stay higher for longer, which puts pressure on gold.

2. One more important date to watch: US jobs data. Strong job numbers could reduce expectations of rate cuts, putting pressure on gold. Weak numbers could support gold prices.

3. What should you do? Gold could remain volatile in the short term. If you’re investing for the long term and want portfolio diversification, consider investing in parts rather than putting in all your money at once.

[Anushka Rathod, Finance, India, AI, Gold]

item.title: Questions you should ask your partner before marriage....
item.dc:creator: Anuskha Rathod · Instagram
item.description:
Questions you should ask your partner before marriage.

Check out the whole post to know what they are!

The whole point of asking these questions is to be transparent with your partner, especially when it comes to money.

It’s okay if you have different money mindsets. You don’t have to agree on everything. But you should be able to discuss it openly.

Some of these conversations might feel uncomfortable, but it’s better to have them now than deal with disappointments or surprises later.

And personally I feel you should be able to talk about everything with your partner.

item.title: Rupee is winning!!...
item.dc:creator: Anuskha Rathod · Instagram
item.description:
Rupee is winning!!
It’s almost at ₹93!

So, what happened?
Check out the whole post to know.

1. 3rd measure was - RBI made panic-buying of dollars more expensive.
When companies expect the rupee to fall further, they rush to buy dollars in advance. This increases demand for dollars and puts even more pressure on the rupee.

To slow this down, RBI has made advance dollar deals more expensive. Banks now have to keep 20% of the amount as cash with RBI.
This discourages companies from booking dollars out of fear.

2. But these measures come at a cost.
India’s forex reserves fell by over $14 billion in a week, reaching a three-month low as of November 13.
A major reason was the fall in the value of RBI’s foreign currency and gold holdings.

3. Thankfully, we also got some support.
Foreign investor inflows and falling crude oil prices have helped the rupee recover.
But the big question is: Will the rupee maintain this momentum or fall back to ₹95–96?
What do you think?

[Anushka Rathod, Finance, India, Rupee, US]

item.title: ▶ Nvidia stock fell 14% yesterday!...
item.dc:creator: Anuskha Rathod · Instagram
item.description:
Nvidia stock fell 14% yesterday!

Why? What went wrong with one of the biggest companies in the world?

Nvidia Is Now Facing:

1. SEC investigation into potential “accounting irregularities”

2. FBI investigation into “Chinese intelligence operations” involving Jensen Huang

3. Allegations of Jensen Huang having an affair with a Chinese spy

4. California investigation into allegedly “misleading shareholders”

5. Criminal investigation into Megaspeed over export control violations

6. Shareholder lawsuit over “undisclosed ties” between Jensen Huang and Megaspeed

7. Congressional investigation into alleged interference with the Megaspeed probe

8. Internal board investigation into “national security and corporate governance failures”

Just 14 days ago, none of these investigations had been publicly reported.

Talk about a turn of events.

The SEC probe is reportedly examining how Nvidia discloses revenue, including reporting sales by customers’ headquarters rather than billing addresses. With Jensen Huang no longer at the helm, finance chief Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO, and the company is expected to be more selective about how it funds AI companies and infrastructure projects.

The concern is no longer just how much Nvidia is earning, but how sustainable its growth is and whether its accounting can withstand regulatory scrutiny.

These are still ongoing investigations, not verdicts. But investors clearly have a lot of questions right now.

[Anushka Rathod, Finance, India, Nvidia, US]

item.title: Don’t switch your job without knowing this....
item.dc:creator: Anuskha Rathod · Instagram
item.description:
Don’t switch your job without knowing this.

Check out the whole reel to know

For more details, keep reading -

1. Your EPF withdrawal becomes tax-free only after 5 years of continuous service.
But that tax-free withdrawal is allowed only in specific cases like medical emergencies, unemployment, moving abroad, house construction, marriage, education, or reasons beyond your control. Not for random withdrawals.

2. Make sure your Date of Joining and Date of Exit are correctly updated by both your previous and current employer.
Fixing it later is possible, but the process becomes lengthy with a lot of back and forth.

3. Also, if there is a gap between your previous company’s Date of Exit and your new company’s Date of Joining, it does not break your continuous EPF service completely. Your service just pauses for that period and continues again once you join the new company.
4. Please note epfo tweeted only about the date of joining and exit, but in the post i have given complete guide on what should be after you leave your job (including EPF account updation)
